verdict.rationale: Plausible ships both a write-side Events API (record pageviews/custom events) and a read-side Stats API (query historical/real-time metrics via /api/v2/query), so a good chunk of core dashboard data is programmatically accessible. However, there's no evidence of API coverage for many UI-only capabilities like configuring funnels/goals, annotations, site/team management, SSO, email/Slack report scheduling, or CSV import/export — and probes show no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs, suggesting the API surface is narrower than the full UI. Missing for 10: API endpoints for funnel/goal configuration, annotations, team/site administration, report scheduling, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming full parity.
